name: Sparkle Gold Rock Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1991, Sparkle Gold Mines Group Ltd is in the business of mining minerals, gold & jewellery, real estate, etc.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
SSMG was primarily engaged in Ginning and Cotton Trading.
a) Cotton was procured from farmers through APMC yards.
b) It was then ginned and sold to spinning 
mills located in South India.
c) Cotton seeds were sold to oil extraction 
units in Karnataka and other states.

cons: Stock is trading at 21.4 times its book value
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
Company has high debtors of 166 days.
